d: These animal calls took Turtleman completely by surprise! This compilation brings together the best moments from Call of the Wildman, featuring Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and his trusted partner Neal James as Team Turtle takes on some of their most unexpected wildlife rescue missions. From snake rescue and snake catching to turtle catching, raccoon catching and mink catching, every call brings a fresh challenge. Watch this animal rescuer tackle wild animal capture, animal catching and wild animal removal missions as he ventures into the unknown to rescue and capture…
